title: Daily Digest A: Injury Watch (Wed Nov 25)
parts:
🩹 DEVYDOSE INJURY WATCH | Wed, Nov 25

Florida's 5-star sophomore WR is done for the year, Texas and Texas A&M both go into Friday short on pass catchers, Penn State is thin at running back, and West Virginia turns to a sophomore QB at Utah 🧵👇

🩹 VERNELL BROWN III | Florida | SO, 5⭐ | #10 WR

Out for the rest of the season. Florida said Tuesday he'll have surgery after rehab and two procedures didn't get him back. He hasn't played since September (via Florida Gators On SI).

🩹 NICK TOWNSEND | Texas | SO, 4⭐ | #108 TE

Out on the first availability report for Texas A&M.

The Aggies list two WRs out: Terry Bussey | JR, 5⭐ | #92 WR and Ashton Bethel-Roman | JR, 4⭐ | #197 WR (via Aggies Wire).

🩹 James Peoples | Penn State | JR, 4⭐ | #111 RB: out vs Maryland. Brett Eskildsen | JR, 3⭐ | #119 WR: "doubtful" (via Penn State).

🔄 Scotty Fox Jr. | West Virginia | SO, 3⭐ | #206 QB starts at Utah. Mike Hawkins is doubtful (via WV Sports Now).

Who hurts most? 👇
